newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks to see little impact from Deng's deAth.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks to see little impact from Deng's deAth.

text.p: The death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping would have little impact on the Seoul stock market on Thursday, brokers said.
They said the local market would drift sideways with selective buying in smaller-capitalised shares.
"The market is not expected to be much affected by Deng's death. The news has long been discounted," said Park Key-pyong of Hanyang Securities.
Brokers said domestic issues would attract more attention, including inter-Korean tension, economic situation and parliamentary rassling over the Hanbo loan scandal.
The composite stock index closed Wednesday 6.73 points lower at 713.67.
Brokers said asset-rich shares, pharmaceuticals and shares targetted by mergers and acquisition talks would continue to be in demand.
